prompts.prompt: Edit target/reference: the supplied south-facing top-down swordsman. Produce a reusable large 2D animation cutout of ONLY HIS HEAD: entire brown hair, ears, face, and a short hidden neck extension. Remove all clothing, scarf, torso, arms, legs and sword. Preserve exactly the reference character identity, hairstyle, face proportions, hand-painted matte brush style and camera angle looking down from above. Head faces directly toward bottom of image, no yaw, no looking up. Reconstruct clean lower neck hidden by scarf for overlap. Single head centered occupying 80% canvas width, large high resolution individual source. Transparent RGBA background, fully opaque inside head, no haze, no ground, no shadow, no text. No new design. This is one separated layer for a rig, NOT a sprite sheet.

Edit reference: supplied south-facing top-down swordsman. Create ONE large separated animation layer of ONLY HIS TORSO, including beige scarf around empty neck opening and hanging scarf end, brown leather chest armor, waist belt and brass buckle, short split leather tunic skirt, small side belt pouch. REMOVE head, hair, shoulder armor, BOTH arms, hands, legs, boots, sword. Fill hidden chest and shoulders naturally for overlap with separate head and arms. Exactly same orthographic elevated top-down angle, south-facing, same proportions, same warm dark brown colors, hand-painted matte brush texture. No redesign. Top starts at shoulders and empty neck opening, bottom ends at split tunic hem. Sleeveless torso with rounded closed shoulder ends for animation overlap. Single torso centered, at least 85% canvas height. Genuine transparent RGBA background, solid opaque garment, no haze/shadow/ground, no labels. Keep scarf sitting like reference. Individual full-size source, not a sheet.

Use supplied swordsman as exact identity costume color and top-down viewpoint reference. Produce TWO separated large animation arm cutouts on a transparent portrait canvas: left half contains the arm on viewer LEFT, with its steel single shoulder pauldron and two brass rivets, dark short sleeve, skin at elbow, brown bracer and CLOSED brown gloved hand; right half contains arm on viewer RIGHT with dark sleeve, skin elbow, same bracer, and brown glove gripping an INVISIBLE narrow sword handle (no sword anywhere). Each arm is a continuous whole limb from rounded shoulder top to fist bottom, straight down in neutral rigging pose. Two arms parallel and vertical, aligned at shoulder and wrist heights, widely separated by a completely transparent vertical gap at exact center. Each arm stays entirely inside its own half, using 85% canvas height, maximum useful source resolution. Same top-down camera, same painted matte brush texture as reference. NO torso head scarf legs sword or background. Reconstruct hidden inner shoulder/arm surfaces cleanly. Opaque material, transparent exterior, no haze or cast shadow, no text, no extra limbs. Exactly two arm layers.

Use supplied top-down south-facing swordsman as exact costume, proportion, camera and painterly style reference. Create TWO separated large full-leg animation cutouts on a transparent portrait canvas. LEFT HALF: his viewer-left leg, entire charcoal trouser thigh from hidden hip attachment through knee down to the chunky brown leather boot and its sole. RIGHT HALF: his viewer-right leg, same parts. No torso tunic skirt belt head arms or sword. Reconstruct hidden upper trouser thigh to make a rounded overlap attachment. Both legs straight and parallel, boot toes point to BOTTOM of canvas, same steep elevated top-down orthographic view as reference, visible boot top planes, NOT side views or eye level. Keep reference short stout boots with wide cuffs and dark soles, chunky compact stylized proportions. Exactly two continuous legs with a wide fully transparent gap along center, each remains strictly within its own half, aligned same top and bottom, fill about 85% image height for large source resolution. Retain original warm matte painted brush texture and simple folds. No labels, no floor, no haze, no shadow. Fully opaque limbs, genuinely transparent outside.

Edit/reference: the supplied south-facing top-down swordsman. Extract and redraw ONLY his simple steel longsword as one large isolated animation layer. No hands, no glove, no character. Same straight steel blade with simple central ridge, modest brass-ended metal crossguard, brown leather narrow grip, small brass pommel. Preserve the practical plain sword design and warm hand-painted matte brush style. Orient perfectly vertically in image: pommel at TOP, grip below it, crossguard near upper quarter, long pointed blade extends DOWN. Symmetric straight narrow blade, no bend, no fancy ornament, no glow. Entire object comfortably within canvas, maximum useful original resolution, fill 88% height. Genuine transparent RGBA exterior, opaque metal and leather. No ground, no shadow, no haze, no text. This is a separate sword layer for the hand to grip in an animated south-facing 2D character.
